discogs.title: Confessions On A Dance Floor
discogs.notes:
Clear jewel case with clear tray. 16-page booklet.

Some copies may also include a disco ball ornament printed on a four inch by four inch square insert around which reads, "Dexter in The Standards and Practices Dept. wouldn't let us make this propaganda into a circle, so you'll have to cut it out yourself. Cut & hang from your rear view mirror & go!" On the reverse side of the insert is information in a spiral text layout for how to join ICON, the official Madonna fan club, to receive an exclusive bonus track from this album, plus other benefits.
